onspawn.moveout * Viervilles Draw victory1 * Allied Victory! American forces have secured the town! victory2 * Axis Victory! German forces have defended the town! roundstop * This round is over! playarea * You are leaving the combat area... turn around! vierville_draw * Vierville Draw
youcapon * You are capturing the town! alliedcapon * American forces are capturing the town! alliedcapoff * Axis forces have re-taken the town!
scenario.help = UP THE DRAW
content.brief: American forces have secured "Dog Green" and now must move up the Vierville Draw to capture a nearby town. The Germans are pounding the Americans with big guns and fight to hold their ground.
